Solving the equation: $|x-4| - 10 = 2$ gives $|x-4| = 12$, so $x - 4 = 12$ or $x - 4 = -12$. That yields $x = 16$ or $x = -8$. Both satisfy the original equation: $|12| - 10 = 2$ and $|-12| - 10 = 2$. The product is $16 \times (-8) = -128$.

Solution 1 reaches this correctly. Solution 2 wrongly sets $-(x-4) - 10 = 2$ to $x-4 = -8$ when it should give $x-4 = -12$, so it gets $x = -4$ and the product $-64$. Solution 3 wrongly takes $x-4$ to be $2$ or $-12$ instead of $\pm 12$, so it gets $-48$.

CHOICE: 1
